 Devils at Capitals projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 14, 2026 
 Link copied 
 DEVILS (14-6-0) at CAPITALS (10-7-0) 
 7 p.m. ET; MNMT, MSG  
 Devils projected lineup 
 Arseny Gritsyuk -- Jack Hughes -- Jesper Bratt
 Timo Meier -- Nico Hischier -- Luke Evangelista
 Stefan Noesen -- Evan Rodrigues -- Connor Brown
 Jesper Boqvist -- Cody Glass -- Lenni Hameenaho
 Jonas Seigenthaler -- Luke Hughes
 Declan Chisholm -- Dougie Hamilton
 Brenden Dillon – Anton Silaev
 Connor Hellebuyck
 Jake Allen
 Scratched: Amadeus Lombardi 
 Injured: Anthony Mantha (throat), Brett Pesce (illness), Johnathan Kovacevic (lower body), Vladislav Kolyachonok (illness) 
 Capitals projected lineup 
 Alex Tuch -- Dylan Strome -- Jordan Kyrou
 Alaiksei Protas -- Pierre-Luc Dubois -- Tom Wilson
 Alex Ovechkin -- Justin Sourdif -- Anthony Beauvillier
 Boone Jenner -- Ilya Protas -- Ryan Leonard
 Jakob Chychrun -- Matt Roy
 Martin Fehervary -- Timothy Liljegren
 Cole Hutson -- Jack St. Ivany
 Charlie Lindgren
 Logan Thompson
 Scratched: Ethen Frank, Ivan Miroshnichenko, Justin Holl 
 Injured: Rasmus Sandin (knee), Vincent Desharnais (appendectomy) 
 Status report 
 Silaev will make his NHL debut after being recalled from Utica of the American Hockey League on Friday. ... Kovacevic, a defenseman, was placed on injured reserve retroactive to Nov. 10. … Lindgren will start. ... Desharnais was on the ice in a non-contact jersey during the Capitals morning skate; the defenseman will miss his ninth straight game.
